channel.title: Texas Solutions Truck Dispatch Blog
channel.description: Truck dispatch, rates, diesel prices and fuel-saving guides for owner-operators and small fleets.

item.title: Box Truck Dispatch: How to Find Loads and What It Really Costs
item.description: How box truck owner-operators find loads, what box trucks earn and spend on fuel, and what box truck dispatch costs (10% of weekly gross at Texas Solutions).

item.title: Diesel Prices by State: How Truckers Cut Fuel Cost Per Mile
item.description: Why diesel prices differ so much between states, how to work out your fuel cost per mile, and practical ways owner-operators cut fuel spend, with a free truck fuel calculator and daily state prices.

item.title: Hotshot Trucking in 2026: Rates Per Mile, Fuel Mileage and Dispatch
item.description: A practical guide to hotshot trucking: typical rates per mile, how load weight affects fuel mileage, what a hotshot dispatcher does, and what dispatch costs (8% of weekly gross at Texas Solutions).

item.title: How Much Does a Truck Dispatcher Cost in 2026? Percentages Explained
item.description: What owner-operators pay for truck dispatch in 2026: typical percentages, what the fee covers, flat vs percentage, and Texas Solutions rates of 5% for semis, 8% for hotshots and 10% for box trucks.
